title: Commercial Registry Notice / Novacliss
summary: Public registry notice documenting the use of the Novacliss name across several commercial operations.
body:
REGISTRY NOTICE

The name NOVACLISS appears in commercial registrations concerning industrial procurement, infrastructure maintenance and private technical services.

The Registry has not determined whether these operations constitute a single corporate entity, a parent group or independently registered businesses using a shared trade designation.

This notice is administrative rather than investigative.

ARCHIVE NOTE

A restricted Brightside record concerning the designation is held under ARC-326-0422.
